## Merge readiness

- [ ] Exact-head required checks are green.
- [ ] Relevant Admin/browser acceptance is green or not in scope.
- [ ] Relevant cross-repo freshness/acceptance is green or not in scope.
- [ ] Every non-required red check is classified below.

### Non-required red/pending checks

Write `None`, or list each check as **BLOCKING**, **UNRELATED**, or **ENVIRONMENTAL** with the evidence/issue link.

> Do not merge solely because GitHub reports `mergeable=true`.
